about: The worldgen feature's things. The Answerers are living would-be listeners in mauve cloth with brass mouthpieces, who speak back to the Voices without understanding them; the Cantor leads their chant with a cracked bell. The Reliquary is a mauve-stone plinth carrying a brass-bound page box; it is survival-unbreakable and never dropped, so its item is exempt and the block carries the value the Tuning Fork reads.
